forbidden: You do not have permission to view financial analytics.
staleData: Refresh failed. The values shown are from the last successful load.

definitions.cash: Confirmed records by received date only. Pending and voided records are excluded; totals are per currency.
definitions.cohort: Registrations whose academy-local registration date falls in the selected range. Payment states are derived as of now.
definitions.funnel: Counts enrollments that ever reached each stage; stages are monotonic and the denominator is all registrations.
definitions.currentFollowUp: Current follow-up state for enrollments in the selected registration cohort.
definitions.topCourses: Top six courses in the registration cohort; remaining courses are grouped as Other.

kpi.publishedCourses: Count of currently published courses; this is a current-state metric.
kpi.draftCourses: Count of courses currently in draft; this is a current-state metric.
kpi.pendingRevisions: Count of revisions currently awaiting review.
kpi.newLeads: Leads created in the selected academy-local date range.
kpi.uniqueCustomers: Distinct lead IDs among enrollments registered in the selected range.
kpi.enrollments: Enrollment records registered in the selected academy-local date range.
kpi.paidEnrollments: Cohort enrollments whose derived payment status is paid as of now.
kpi.partiallyPaid: Cohort enrollments whose derived payment status is partially paid as of now.
kpi.unpaid: Cohort enrollments currently unpaid or pending; pending is not revenue.
kpi.netRevenue: Confirmed payments minus confirmed refunds received in the selected date range, for the selected currency.
kpi.refunds: Confirmed refund records received in the selected range, for the selected currency.
kpi.outstanding: Current outstanding snapshot over non-cancelled, priced enrollments; independent of date range.
kpi.conversion: Paid enrollments divided by all cohort enrollments, including cancelled enrollments.

sectionEmpty: No data for this section and filter combination.
noAttribution: No attribution information exists in this range.
